subject.title: fix: recover stranded replies in message_tool_only mode (#85714)

question: Should issue #85714 be resolved through this opt-in `messages.strandedReplyRecovery` retry, through successor PR #99536's default-on guarded recovery, or by keeping warning-only behavior?
rationale: The branch changes a documented privacy-sensitive delivery contract and adds a new config surface, which is a product policy choice rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Use default-on sanitized recovery
options.body: Prefer the successor shape that removes the new config knob and recovers only the narrow stranded-final class with sanitized text and diagnostic fallback.

options.title: Keep opt-in recovery
options.body: Allow this PR's config-gated mode after sanitizing retry text and documenting that operators intentionally opt into replaying private finals through a retry.

options.title: Stay warning-only
options.body: Reject automatic recovery for now and keep `message_tool_only` as a strict private-final contract with operator diagnostics only.

recommendation.title: Use default-on sanitized recovery
recommendation.body: Prefer the successor shape that removes the new config knob and recovers only the narrow stranded-final class with sanitized text and diagnostic fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a repository-wide product/privacy contract decision, and this handle is an official maintainer who merged the warning-only baseline PR.
